questions.question: A shareholder's real power over the directors of Masakhane Ltd is exercised by:
options: Voting at the annual general meeting — electing directors and removing those who fail
Signing the company's cheques
Setting the directors' daily tasks
Approving each transaction before it is recorded

questions.question: A director's fiduciary duty requires the director to:
options: Guarantee a dividend every year
Act in good faith in the company's best interests, never for private advantage, declaring any personal interest
Own at least half of the company's shares
Audit the financial statements personally

questions.question: An INDEPENDENT non-executive director is one who:
options: Works in the company every day
Is related to the chief executive
Has no other financial connection to the company — which is what makes the director's judgement trustworthy
Holds the most shares on the board

questions.question: Good governance prefers the chairperson and the chief executive to be different people because:
options: The law forbids one person holding two titles
It halves the directors' fees
The chairperson must live in another city
One person leading both the board and the company concentrates the power governance exists to divide

subtopics.title: The King Code and Its Four Demands

questions.question: The legal status of the King Code is that it is:
options: A code of good practice, not an Act of Parliament — though the JSE requires listed companies to apply and explain it
A criminal statute enforced by the police
A section of the Income Tax Act
An internal policy each company writes for itself

questions.question: A board conceals a disastrous half-year from its shareholders. The King Code demands most directly broken are:
options: Fairness and competence
Transparency, with accountability alongside it
Confidentiality and integrity
Responsibility only

questions.question: The demand of FAIRNESS requires the board to:
options: Pay every stakeholder the same amount
Always follow the majority shareholder's wishes
Weigh the legitimate interests of all stakeholders — minorities, employees, creditors, customers, the community
Distribute all profit as dividends

questions.question: The remuneration committee exists so that:
options: Shareholders can set their own dividends
The auditor can approve salaries
Executive pay can remain secret
Directors do not set their own pay — and transparency then requires that pay to be disclosed director by director

subtopics.title: Professional Ethics and the Code of Conduct

questions.question: The financial director is instructed to record January's sales in December. The principle that requires refusal is:
options: Integrity — the statements would no longer fairly present the year
Confidentiality — the sales are secret
Professional behaviour — January is a holiday month
Competence — the entry is too difficult

questions.question: A director's brother bids for the company's delivery contract. The correct procedure is:
options: Award the contract to the brother if his quote is cheapest
Declare the connection, withdraw from the decision, and let the remaining directors choose on merit
Keep the connection private but vote honestly
Cancel the contract so no decision is needed

questions.question: A director buys shares after learning of a transforming contract win the market does not yet know about. This is:
options: Sound investing rewarded by the law
Share-price manipulation
Insider trading — dealing on information the market lacks, illegal under South African financial markets law
Permitted if the shares are held for a year

questions.question: Share-price manipulation differs from insider trading in that manipulation involves:
options: Buying shares at the JSE's opening price
Trading only after results are published
Holding shares in a competitor
Spreading false information or arranging artificial trades to push the price where it should not go

subtopics.title: Internal Control, Internal Audit and the Independent Audit

questions.question: Division of duties as an internal control means:
options: The person who orders never pays, and the person who pays never records
Every employee learns every job
The directors do all the bookkeeping
Duties are rotated once a decade

questions.question: Internal audit reports its findings to the audit committee rather than only to the managers tested because:
options: The managers cannot read audit reports
A finding that embarrasses a manager, reported only to that manager, tends to vanish
The audit committee performs the repairs itself
The external auditor forbids other reporting lines

questions.question: The independent auditor is appointed by:
options: The directors, at a board meeting
The financial director
The shareholders at the annual general meeting — and reports to them on whether the statements fairly present the position
The internal audit team

questions.question: In the chain of accountability, every arrow ultimately points toward:
options: SARS
The audit committee
The chief executive
The shareholders — management answers to the board, the board to the owners, and both audits work on the owners' behalf

questions.question: Sondela's hundred and fifty members elect a committee of seven because:
options: A hundred and fifty people cannot run one club — owners keep the power to appoint and remove, the committee manages
Only seven members paid their fees
The law limits clubs to seven members
The committee owns the club

questions.question: Among the powers the members KEEP is the right to:
options: Order the kit each season
Choose an outside person, connected to nobody on the committee, to check the books
Hold the bank card
Set the fixtures

questions.question: "The treasurer's rand is not the treasurer's" expresses the idea that:
options: Treasurers may not be paid
The club may not hold cash
Committee power is held on the members' behalf — the company version is called fiduciary duty
Only the chairperson may spend money

questions.question: The members' strongest response to a committee that runs the club badly is to:
options: Stop attending matches
Burn the receipt book
Split into two clubs
Vote the committee out at the next annual general meeting

subtopics.title: House Rules That Keep the Money Clean

questions.question: The one-question test for ACCOUNTABILITY in the club is:
options: Does anyone spend money and answer to nobody?
Did the first team win the league?
Is the joining fee high enough?
Does the treasurer live near the clubhouse?

questions.question: Reporting a bad season as a bad season, with the books open, is the club version of:
options: Fairness
Transparency — a committee that shares only good news is hiding something
Competence
Confidentiality

questions.question: Zanele ordering the match dresses from her sister's shop without quotes is a breach EVEN IF the price was reasonable, because:
options: Family members may never trade with a club
Match dresses must be imported
The decision was never protected from her bias — the interest was not declared and no comparison was made
Treasurers may not place orders at all

questions.question: The clean repair of Zanele's conflict is to:
options: Ban her sister's shop from ever quoting
Let Zanele choose but at a discount
Keep the connection quiet and hope the price stays fair
Declare the connection, step out of the decision, let the committee gather three quotes, and minute the choice and reasons

questions.question: Gate takings counted by one member, written up by a second and banked by a third is the club version of:
options: Division of duties — the counter is never the recorder
The independent audit
The remuneration committee
Insider trading

questions.question: Everyday controls protect honest people too, because:
options: They make the club richer
When nothing is missing, the treasurer can PROVE nothing is missing
They remove the need for any audit
They guarantee the team wins

questions.question: Karabo — inside the club, checking all year, reporting to the oversight group — corresponds to:
options: The external auditor
The shareholders
Internal audit, whose findings go to those overseeing rather than only to the person tested
The remuneration committee

questions.question: The three-move method for any governance scenario question is:
options: Quote, calculate, conclude
Debit, credit, balance
Read, memorise, repeat
State the problem, name the principle broken, recommend the remedy that closes it
